tok 1.0 "Customer acquisition"

pool org "Company"
  lane marketing "Marketing"
    start begin "Customer details needed"
    xor how "How are details obtained?"
    task buy "Buy details for cold calls"
    task exhibit "Participate in exhibitions"
    task know "Use personal acquaintance"
    xor got
  lane callcenter "Call center"
    task call "Call the customer"
    task determine "Determine contact person and budget"
    task ask "Ask whether customer is interested"
    xor interested "Interested?"
    xor huge "Budget huge?"
    end leave "Customer left alone"
  lane head "Head of development"
    task acquire "Acquire the customer personally"
    end acquired "Customer acquisition attempted"
  lane presales "Pre-sales"
    task technical "Give technical online presentation"
  lane sales "Sales representative"
    xor kind "Technical presentation?"
    task present "Give online presentation"
    xor presented
    eventgw wait "Wait for customer"
    catch back "Customer contacts us" message="Customer contact"
    catch late "2 weeks passed" timer=P14D
    task remind "Call the customer again"
    xor merge
    task quote "Create quotation"
    end done "Quotation created"

flow begin -> how
flow how -> buy "bought"
flow how -> exhibit "exhibition"
flow how -> know "acquaintance"
flow buy -> got
flow exhibit -> got
flow know -> got
flow got -> call -> determine -> ask -> interested
flow interested -> kind "yes"
flow interested -> huge "no"
flow huge -> acquire "yes"
flow huge -> leave "no"
flow acquire -> acquired
flow kind -> technical "yes"
flow kind -> present "no"
flow technical -> presented
flow present -> presented
flow presented -> wait
flow wait -> back
flow wait -> late
flow back -> merge
flow late -> remind -> merge
flow merge -> quote -> done
